problem: Tesla wanted to speed up the shift to electric vehicles and argued patents often stifle progress.
title: Tesla pledges not to sue good-faith users of its patents
context: Tesla held about 203 patents and 280 pending applications at the end of 2013.
decision_made: Promise not to initiate patent lawsuits against anyone using its technology in good faith.
action_taken: Announced in a blog post on 12 June 2014 by CEO Elon Musk.
observed_outcome: Not documented in the sources used.
lessons: A pledge with a good-faith clause leaves the company deciding who qualifies, so its practical reach is debated.
limitations: Only the announcement and early commentary were checked. Experts disagreed about how much the pledge gave away.

claims.claim_text: Tesla said it would not initiate patent lawsuits against anyone using its technology in good faith.
Musk argued patents often stifle progress rather than encourage it.
